You are an SRE agent tasked with diagnosing issues in a Kubernetes application.

Application: OpenTelemetry Demo Astronomy Shop
Namespace: astronomy-shop

An online shopping platform built with a microservices architecture, showcasing OpenTelemetry instrumentation for distributed tracing across services.

CRITICAL: You are running in an AUTOMATED environment. Work autonomously and make all decisions yourself. DO NOT ask for user confirmation or approval. Proceed with the best solution based on your analysis.

TASK: DIAGNOSIS
- Investigate the application to detect any anomalies or issues
- Analyze metrics, logs, and traces
- When ready, submit a natural language description of the issue you found
- Your diagnosis is evaluated on whether you correctly identify the faulty components and root cause

Important:
- You can query metrics and traces through the available observability tools

report.summary: The checkout Service in namespace astronomy-shop is down because its Deployment's pod template carries a nodeSelector that no node in the cluster satisfies: kubernetes.io/hostname=extra-node. Both live checkout pods (checkout-54579c864c-qz4l4, checkout-c69887c97-z8pxz) are Pending with PodScheduled=False/Unschedulable, the scheduler reporting '0/4 nodes are available ... 3 node(s) didn't match Pod's node affinity/selector' against nodes sregym-control-plane, sregym-worker, sregym-worker2 and sregym-worker3 (none labelled extra-node). Consequently the checkout Deployment reports Available=False (MinimumReplicasUnavailable, 2 unavailable) and kube_deployment_status_replicas_available{deployment="checkout"}=0, and the checkout Endpoints object has no addresses although every other service's Endpoints has at least one. The user-visible consequence is observed on frontend itself: its POST /api/checkout spans fail with HTTP 500 and its child oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder spans fail with gRPC 14 UNAVAILABLE 'connect ECONNREFUSED 10.96.138.219:8080', i.e. the checkout Service ClusterIP, and the frontend container logs repeat the same ECONNREFUSED to that IP from 16:50:47 to 16:50:54. The last-applied configuration recorded for the Deployment contains no nodeSelector and recorded readyReplicas 1 at 16:50:18, so the selector appears to have been added by the template changes at 16:50:40/16:50:47 that produced ReplicaSets checkout-54579c864c and checkout-c69887c97 and killed the previously running pod checkout-6c769b88b5-wg64j; who or what applied that change is not visible in the available data (change history is not integrated). No flagd fault flag is enabled and no other astronomy-shop Deployment declares a nodeSelector.

claims.text: Deployment checkout in namespace astronomy-shop has spec.template.spec.nodeSelector {"kubernetes.io/hostname":"extra-node"}, spec.replicas 1, and status {replicas 2, unavailableReplicas 2, observedGeneration 2, Available=False reason MinimumReplicasUnavailable}.

The Deployment status condition reads: Deployment does not have minimum availability (reason MinimumReplicasUnavailable) and the checkout Deployment shows readyReplicas null / availableReplicas null with unavailable 2, while all 22 other astronomy-shop Deployments show ready 1 and available 1.
Among the 23 Deployments in namespace astronomy-shop, only checkout declares a nodeSelector (kubernetes.io/hostname=extra-node); every other Deployment's nodeSelector is null.

The cluster has exactly four nodes with kubernetes.io/hostname labels sregym-control-plane, sregym-worker, sregym-worker2 and sregym-worker3; only sregym-control-plane carries a taint (node-role.kubernetes.io/control-plane:NoSchedule). No node carries kubernetes.io/hostname=extra-node.

Pods checkout-54579c864c-qz4l4 and checkout-c69887c97-z8pxz are both phase Pending with condition PodScheduled=False, reason Unschedulable, message '0/4 nodes are available: 1 node(s) had untolerated taint {node-role.kubernetes.io/control-plane: }, 3 node(s) didn't match Pod's node affinity/selector', and both pods carry nodeSelector kubernetes.io/hostname=extra-node.

FailedScheduling Warning events name the same unschedulable pods with the same 0/4-nodes message at 2026-11-21T16:50:40Z (checkout-54579c864c-qz4l4) and 2026-11-21T16:50:47Z (checkout-c69887c97-z8pxz), and a Normal Killing event at 16:50:40Z records 'Stopping container checkout' for the previous pod checkout-6c769b88b5-wg64j.

kube_deployment_status_replicas_available{namespace="astronomy-shop",deployment="checkout"} evaluates to 0 at 2026-11-21T16:50:58Z, and the only two returned samples of that series (16:50:30Z and 16:50:45Z) are also 0.

The Endpoints object for service checkout has no addresses (subsets null) at query time, whereas the 22 other astronomy-shop Endpoints objects each list at least one address (for example cart 10.244.234.141, payment 10.244.7.208, product-catalog 10.244.234.175).

Service checkout has clusterIP 10.96.138.219 (port 8080, selector opentelemetry.io/name=checkout); the two Pending checkout pods do carry the label opentelemetry.io/name=checkout, so the empty Endpoints is not a selector mismatch.

frontend spans show POST /api/checkout returning http.status_code 500 with otel.status_code ERROR, and the child span oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder in the same traces carrying rpc.grpc.status_code 14 with grpc.error_message '14 UNAVAILABLE: No connection established. Last error: connect ECONNREFUSED 10.96.138.219:8080 (2026-11-21T16:50:50.583Z)' (also 16:50:48.421Z).

The frontend container's own log lines show repeated 'Error: 14 UNAVAILABLE: No connection established. Last error: connect ECONNREFUSED 10.96.138.219:8080' at 16:50:47.419Z, 16:50:48.421Z, 16:50:50.583Z and 16:50:54Z; earlier refused connections at 16:49:56-16:50:02Z were to product-catalog (10.96.191.110), cart (10.96.249.158) and ad (10.96.114.255) during the cluster startup wave.

The checkout Deployment's kubectl.kubernetes.io/last-applied-configuration (metadata generation 1, revision 1) contains no nodeSelector and its embedded status records readyReplicas 1, availableReplicas 1 and 'Deployment has minimum availability' at 2026-11-21T16:50:18Z; the live object is generation 2 with the nodeSelector present.

Both checkout ReplicaSets are owned by Deployment checkout, were created at 2026-11-21T16:50:40Z (checkout-54579c864c) and 2026-11-21T16:50:47Z (checkout-c69887c97), carry the same image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.2.0-checkout and the same nodeSelector kubernetes.io/hostname=extra-node, and have readyReplicas null.

Deployment ScalingReplicaSet events show every astronomy-shop Deployment scaled 0→1 between 16:49:44Z and 16:49:47Z, and checkout scaled a further ReplicaSet up at 16:50:40Z (checkout-54579c864c) and 16:50:47Z (checkout-c69887c97) — the only post-startup scaling events in the namespace.

26 of the 28 pods in namespace astronomy-shop are phase Running and ready with restartCount 0; the only pods not running are checkout-54579c864c-qz4l4 and checkout-c69887c97-z8pxz in phase Pending with no container statuses.
The flagd ConfigMap 'flagd-config' (key demo.flagd.json) contains no flag whose defaultVariant is other than off/false/disabled, so no flagd-injected checkout fault is evidenced as active.

The failure is not a cluster-wide connectivity or readiness outage: every other astronomy-shop Endpoints object has at least one address and their backing pods are Running/Ready with 0 restarts, so only checkout lacks serving pods.

Checkout containers crashing or being OOM-killed is rejected: checkout-54579c864c-qz4l4 and checkout-c69887c97-z8pxz never got a node assignment (PodScheduled=False) and report no container statuses or restart counts; the failure is pre-container scheduling.

A Service selector mismatch or a network policy blocking frontend→checkout is rejected as the cause of the refused connections: the Pending pods carry the selector label opentelemetry.io/name=checkout, and the scheduler message attributes the block explicitly to node affinity/selector, not to network or quota constraints.

Grafana readiness-probe failures at 16:49:54Z, opensearch-0 startup-probe failures at 16:50:15Z, an otel-collector-agent-884n2 ConfigMap-cache mount timeout at 16:49:46Z and Killing of otel-collector-agent pods at 16:50:28-16:50:33Z occurred during the 16:49:44Z cluster start wave; grafana, opensearch-0 and the running otel-collector-agent pods are now Running/Ready with 0 restarts and none of these objects is checkout.

The nodeSelector kubernetes.io/hostname=extra-node was injected into the checkout Deployment's pod template by the change(s) that produced ReplicaSets checkout-54579c864c (16:50:40Z) and checkout-c69887c97 (16:50:47Z), i.e. after the healthy revision-1 state at 16:50:18Z; the actor, channel and exact time of that template change are not observable with the available data.

An alternative explanation for the same symptom is that a node labelled kubernetes.io/hostname=extra-node once existed and was removed or relabelled, making an unchanged selector unsatisfiable; the current four-node inventory cannot confirm or refute that history.

Remove the nodeSelector kubernetes.io/hostname=extra-node from Deployment checkout (or, if that placement is truly intended, label/add a node with kubernetes.io/hostname=extra-node and verify the taints), then confirm new checkout pods reach Running/Ready and that the checkout Endpoints object gains an address before re-testing POST /api/checkout.

Add alerting on kube_deployment_status_replicas_available{deployment="checkout"} dropping below spec.replicas and on the checkout Endpoints object having zero addresses, and enable/consult audit or change-history so the origin of pod-template edits can be attributed.

gaps: Change history is not integrated in this Run, so who or what added nodeSelector kubernetes.io/hostname=extra-node to Deployment checkout, and at which instant, cannot be determined; the change is only bracketed between the revision-1 state recorded at 16:50:18Z and the ReplicaSet creation at 16:50:40Z/16:50:47Z.
No node named or labelled extra-node exists now (four nodes: sregym-control-plane, sregym-worker, sregym-worker2, sregym-worker3); whether such a node ever existed in this cluster cannot be verified.

The previously running pod checkout-6c769b88b5-wg64j no longer exists, so its termination reason and exit code could not be read; only the Normal Killing event 'Stopping container checkout' at 16:50:40Z was observed.

Prometheus span-metric queries (sum by service_name,status_code of increase(traces_span_metrics_calls_total[...]) over 10m/30m/1h ending 2026-11-21T16:50:58Z) returned no samples (status no_data), so a checkout or frontend span-metric error rate could not be computed; impact quantification relies on the biased Jaeger sample and frontend logs.
NetworkPolicy and ResourceQuota queries for namespace astronomy-shop returned zero rows (status no_data), so their absence is unconfirmed rather than proven.

Logs of all other services were not read; an error-filtered read of payment-556cf8d457-vpnqs returned no matching lines (status no_data), so payment's health is not positively established, only that its pod is Running/Ready with 0 restarts.

The otel-collector-agent DaemonSet pods were killed/recreated around 16:50:28-16:50:33Z and one pod hit a ConfigMap-cache mount timeout at 16:49:46Z; the cause of that DaemonSet rollout (and whether it affected telemetry collection completeness during the window) is not determined and is not tied to the checkout failure.

Two checkout ReplicaSets were created 7 seconds apart (16:50:40Z, 16:50:47Z) with identical image and nodeSelector; what changed between those two template revisions could not be determined from the available data.
next_steps: Inspect cluster audit logs or the deployment pipeline/helm values that produced generation 2 of Deployment checkout to identify who set nodeSelector kubernetes.io/hostname=extra-node and whether a node named extra-node was decommissioned.

After the selector is corrected, verify checkout pods become Ready, the checkout Endpoints object lists a pod address, and frontend POST /api/checkout returns HTTP 200 with oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder rpc.grpc.status_code 0.

Apply a scheduling guardrail (admission policy or pre-merge check) that rejects pod templates whose nodeSelector cannot match any existing node label, and confirm the otel-collector-agent DaemonSet rollout at 16:50:28-16:50:33Z was legitimate telemetry-config maintenance.
